Train a custom deep-learning classifier with consensus label cleaning

Source: R/deep_learning.R
train_custom_dl.Rd

Drop-in deep-learning counterpart to train_custom_randomforest. Same two-stage workflow: repeated stratified cross-validation is used to flag unreliable labels (consensus cleaning), then a final network is trained on the cleaned labelled cells. Uses a small feedforward neural network (via the torch package) instead of ranger.

Usage

train_custom_dl(
  spe,
  label_col = "cutoff_label",
  assay_name = "exprs",
  unknown_label = "Unknown",
  features = "all",
  hidden_dims = c(64, 32),
  dropout = 0.3,
  epochs = 50,
  lr = 0.001,
  weight_decay = 1e-04,
  batch_size = 256,
  cv_folds = 5,
  repeats = 3,
  agreement_thresh = 0.8,
  val_frac = 0.15,
  patience = 10,
  verbose_training = FALSE,
  class_balanced_loss = TRUE,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

spe

A SpatialExperiment or SingleCellExperiment.

label_col

Character scalar naming the label column in colData(spe) (default "cutoff_label").

assay_name

Character scalar naming the assay used as features (default "exprs").

unknown_label

Character label treated as unlabeled and excluded from training/cleaning (default "Unknown").

features

Character vector of feature (marker) names to use, or "all" to use all assay rows (default "all").

hidden_dims

Integer vector of hidden layer sizes (default c(64, 32)).

dropout

Dropout probability applied after each hidden layer (default 0.3).

epochs

Integer maximum training epochs per fold/final fit; actual training usually stops earlier via early stopping (see patience) once validation loss stops improving (default 100).

lr

Learning rate for Adam (default 1e-3).

weight_decay

L2 penalty for Adam (default 1e-4).

batch_size

Minibatch size (default 256).

cv_folds

Integer number of folds used for stratified cross-validation (default 5).

repeats

Integer number of repeated CV rounds used during consensus cleaning (default 3; kept lower than the random-forest default since each round trains a full network rather than a fast forest).

agreement_thresh

Numeric in [0,1] specifying the minimum agreement rate required to keep an originally labelled cell during cleaning (default 0.8).

val_frac

Fraction of each training set held out (stratified by class) as a validation split for best-epoch selection and early stopping (default 0.15).

patience

Integer epochs to wait for validation-loss improvement before stopping early; set to NULL to disable early stopping (default 10).

verbose_training

Logical; if TRUE, print per-epoch train/val loss during the final model fit (the CV/cleaning-stage folds always stay quiet to avoid flooding the console). Default FALSE.

class_balanced_loss

Logical; if TRUE (default), weight the loss by inverse class frequency to counter class imbalance.

seed

Optional integer seed for reproducibility.

Value

A named list with components:

spe

The input spe with an added colData column cleaned_core_label, mirroring train_custom_randomforest.

model

An object of class "cytoGateR_dl" wrapping the trained torch network together with the feature names, class levels, and scaling stats needed to reproduce predictions.

core_prob_mat

Consensus probability matrix for the kept cells.

agreement_rates

Named numeric vector of per-cell agreement rates.

features_used

Character vector of feature names used for training.

training_history

Per-epoch train/val loss for the *final* model fit (not the CV/cleaning folds), plus which epoch was selected as best.

Examples

# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("torch", quietly = TRUE) &&
    torch::torch_is_installed()) {
  data("cytoGateR_example", package = "cytoGateR")
  image_ids <- SummarizedExperiment::colData(cytoGateR_example)$image_name
  spe <- cytoGateR_example[, image_ids == image_ids[1L]]
  dl_fit <- train_custom_dl(
    spe,
    label_col = "core_group",
    unknown_label = "Unassigned",
    features = c("CD3e", "CD20", "CD4", "CD8a"),
    hidden_dims = 8,
    epochs = 2,
    batch_size = 256,
    cv_folds = 2,
    repeats = 1,
    agreement_thresh = 0,
    patience = 1,
    seed = 1
  )
  dl_fit$training_history
}
# }
